feature_convention.aligned_semantics: box shifted by -0.5 feature units; [0,1] samples cell 0 exactly
feature_convention.double_scaling_guard: no spatial_scale=1/stride path exists in this module

learning_spec.b_decision: vote iff |q_i - q_j| >= tau_q via r = clip(0.5 + (q_i-q_j) * delta_pref / (2*tau_q), 0, 1); no abstain head
learning_spec.b_loss: mean squared error against the member's matched-GT IoU
learning_spec.c_invalid_read_maps_to: infeasible (no vote), same outcome as infeasible_read
learning_spec.loss_abstain: binary_cross_entropy(a, z) averaged over ALL pairs of the batch; z = 1 cross-GT (abstain pairs), z = 0 same-GT (preference pairs)
learning_spec.loss_pref: binary_cross_entropy(r, y) averaged over the preference-labelled pairs of the batch (term 0.0 when the batch holds none)
learning_spec.shuffle: torch.randperm with torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261030); the generator advances across epochs, so the order is deterministic and reshuffled
